datasets.name: Zachary's karate club
datasets.description: Social network of a university karate club that split in two.
datasets.source: W. W. Zachary, J. Anthropol. Res. 33, 452 (1977). Clustering hierarchy from ImsvGraphVis (O.-H. Kwon et al., IEEE TVCG 22(7), 2016).

datasets.name: Dolphins
datasets.description: Frequent associations among 62 bottlenose dolphins in Doubtful Sound, New Zealand.
datasets.source: D. Lusseau et al., Behav. Ecol. Sociobiol. 54, 396 (2003). Clustering hierarchy from ImsvGraphVis (O.-H. Kwon et al., IEEE TVCG 22(7), 2016).

datasets.name: Les Misérables
datasets.description: Co-appearance of characters in Victor Hugo’s novel.
datasets.source: D. E. Knuth, The Stanford GraphBase (1993). Clustering hierarchy from ImsvGraphVis (O.-H. Kwon et al., IEEE TVCG 22(7), 2016).

datasets.name: Political books
datasets.description: Books about US politics co-purchased on Amazon around the 2004 election.
datasets.source: V. Krebs, unpublished; via M. Newman. Clustering hierarchy from ImsvGraphVis (O.-H. Kwon et al., IEEE TVCG 22(7), 2016).

datasets.name: Adjectives & nouns
datasets.description: Adjacency of common adjectives and nouns in Dickens’ David Copperfield.
datasets.source: M. E. J. Newman, Phys. Rev. E 74, 036104 (2006). Clustering hierarchy from ImsvGraphVis (O.-H. Kwon et al., IEEE TVCG 22(7), 2016).

datasets.name: College football
datasets.description: Games between Division IA colleges, fall 2000 season.
datasets.source: M. Girvan and M. E. J. Newman, PNAS 99, 7821 (2002). Clustering hierarchy from ImsvGraphVis (O.-H. Kwon et al., IEEE TVCG 22(7), 2016).

datasets.name: Serengeti food web
datasets.description: Feeding links among plants and herbivores of the Serengeti ecosystem.
datasets.source: E. B. Baskerville et al., PLoS Comput. Biol. 7, e1002321 (2011). Clustering hierarchy from ImsvGraphVis (O.-H. Kwon et al., IEEE TVCG 22(7), 2016).

datasets.name: C. elegans neurons
datasets.description: Neural network of the nematode C. elegans (treated as undirected).
datasets.source: D. J. Watts and S. H. Strogatz, Nature 393, 440 (1998). Clustering hierarchy from ImsvGraphVis (O.-H. Kwon et al., IEEE TVCG 22(7), 2016).

datasets.name: Ring of 24 cliques
datasets.description: 24 cliques of 8 joined in a ring. Every edge and label is legible; clusters are unambiguous.
datasets.source: Generated: Ring of cliques (webgpu-graph-vis src/data/generators.js), seed 1

datasets.name: Communities · 500
datasets.description: Hierarchical SBM: 5 groups of 5 communities, average degree 10. Readable labels, visible individual edges.

datasets.name: LFR · 2k
datasets.description: LFR benchmark, 2,000 nodes, power-law degrees and community sizes, μ = 0.2. Labels on hover/zoom.

datasets.name: Communities · 5k
datasets.description: Hierarchical SBM, 5,000 nodes in 3 nested levels, average degree 16. Clear bundles at every level.

datasets.name: Hubs and satellites · 3k
datasets.description: 6 groups of 8 systems: a hub with satellites, some with moons. Tree-like, strong hubs, a clear two-level hierarchy.
datasets.source: Generated: Hubs and satellites (webgpu-graph-vis src/data/generators.js), seed 1

datasets.name: Scale-free · 5k
datasets.description: Barabási–Albert, 5,000 nodes, 4 edges per node: hubs and weak communities. Hard case for bundling.

datasets.name: LFR · 10k
datasets.description: LFR benchmark, 10,000 nodes, average degree 16, μ = 0.25. Structure overview at medium scale.

datasets.name: Communities · 20k
datasets.description: Hierarchical SBM, 20,000 nodes, average degree 24 (240k edges), 3 nested levels. Target scale.

datasets.name: LFR · 20k dense
datasets.description: LFR benchmark, 20,000 nodes, average degree 40 (≈400k edges), μ = 0.3. Maximum stress test.

datasets.name: 3D lattice 12³
datasets.description: 1,728-node cubic grid. Layout sanity check: should unfold into a box.

datasets.name: Geometric 3D · 3k
datasets.description: Random geometric graph, 3,000 points in a cube, average degree 10. Layout sanity check: a solid blob.

datasets.name: Torus mesh 60×30
datasets.description: 1,800-node triangle mesh wrapped both ways. Layout sanity check: should unfold into a torus.

datasets.name: Small world · 2k
datasets.description: Watts–Strogatz ring, 2,000 nodes, 8 neighbors, 2% rewiring. Should lay out as a closed loop.
